name: ase_refresh
contents: Opaque refresh secret; HttpOnly, so application JavaScript cannot read it. SameSite=Strict; path /api/auth. Secure is set according to installation configuration.
duration: Configured refresh-token lifetime (code default 14 days), renewed during refresh and cleared on sign-out. Revocation can invalidate it earlier.

name: ase_csrf
purpose: Strictly necessary protection against cross-site request forgery.
contents: Random token read by the app for protected requests. SameSite=Strict; path /. Secure is set according to installation configuration.
duration: Same configured lifetime as the refresh cookie; cleared on sign-out.

name: ase-globe-prefs
contents: Base map and lite-mode preferences, not research records.
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase-shell-prefs
contents: Whether the left navigation rail is collapsed.
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase-preferences
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase.map.tool-favourites
contents: Up to four public tool identifiers.
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase.brand-motion
purpose: Remember the device's requested animation choice.
contents: The word paused or running. Signed-in account motion settings are separately stored on the server.
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase.embed-consent.v1
purpose: Remember external-media choices across visits only after the separate explicit checkbox.
contents: Schema version and selected provider identifiers. The default choice is held only in page memory.
duration: Until withdrawn in Settings, External media, or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase-push-device
purpose: Associate this browser with the account that enabled push.
contents: Account identifier and a hash of the push endpoint. The browser also holds a push subscription and permission; the server stores its endpoint and encryption keys.
duration: Until push is disabled, replaced or site data is cleared. Browser permission and server device removal are separate controls.

name: ase.start-here.*
purpose: Remember the orientation card for each account.
contents: Account identifier in the key and shown/dismissed choice.
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.

name: ase-notifications-seen:*
purpose: Keep the notification bell from resurfacing previously seen items.
contents: Account identifier in the key and last-seen timestamp.
duration: Until replaced or site data is cleared; no automatic expiry.
